card.name: Linking words inside descriptive lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas that sit just before the next descriptive item. Examples are 'that', 'to', 'how', 'a' or a comma in a list of adjectives, in general web prose about topics and organizations.

modes.label: Relative or infinitive link
modes.description: A word like 'that' or 'to' that begins a clause describing what something does.
modes.example: and genes<< that>> may influence course and severity.

modes.label: Comma in adjective list
modes.description: A comma between stacked adjectives before the final item.
modes.example: is an attempt to help create interactive<<,>> emotionally intelligent, synthetic companions

modes.label: Other joining word
modes.description: A word like 'how', 'a' or a noun that sets up the next phrase in a list or slogan.
modes.example: In other words,<< how>> we receive information about color.
